target.source: rules draft4.1 §2.1 / Step0 v0.7 unique row

a7_script.note: frozen A7 procedure (family_data / lift / nearest_clone / witness_search / statuses / add_row) executed as a prefix; the new 9 points per family x surviving size are classified with the SAME code as the 3 frozen anchors

twelve_assets.rule: build_twelve_assets on the source-bound registry (registered generator; E2 streamed two-pass at 1e-4); intake by regeneration; asset SHA

geometry_acceptance.rule: every one of the 12 points of every surviving size must have observational_status == no_nondegenerate_circles (the registered surviving status) and the first 3 points must reproduce the frozen A7 primary rows (d_clone, statuses) exactly; prior weights 1/12 recorded
geometry_acceptance.excluded_if: any new point has circles geometrically present or an exclusion witness -> that family x size design is NOT accepted (recorded; no automatic re-design)

calibration.role: whitening (mu, W = L^-1 from the f64 calibration bank; rules §10.1) and A10 official cross-check; NOT the null pool

null_pool.role: the registered isotropic null pool (3 x N_W2 rows, 6000 clusters; rules §10.1); f64 primary and paired f32 for the selection bounds; whitened with the calibration mu/W

shared_null.whitening: mu, W = L^-1 from the f64 CALIBRATION bank applied to both null pool paths

a10_cross_check.rule: T1 and T2 relative error < 1e-9 on all compared rows, plane identity 100%, cid/rows/shape identical, compared prefix == min(N_cal, reference rows) recorded; failure stops before whitening / OT

note: science pins for B-3-2 (registered assets); no self-referencing commit/inventory hashes
